<!-- 2) Route portion (CH46, 28&CHARL, MCC5_1) -->
<!-- TSP condition column: on/off (0/1) -->
<!-- TSP off= Anything before 02-03-2025 is TSP OFF -->
<!-- TSP on= 2025-02-03 12pm to 2025-02-10 12pm  -->
<!-- TSP ON [schedlue Cond]= 2025-02-10 12 pm to 2025-04-28 -->
<!-- TSP OFF= 2025-04-28 12pm to 2025-05-05 12pm  -->
<!-- TSP ON= 2025-05-05 12pm to 2025-05-12 at 12pm -->
<!-- TSP on [headway cond]= 2025-05-12 12pm to CURRENT/LAST DATE -->

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(broom)


wego <- read_csv("../data/Route 50 Timepoint and Headway Data, 1-1-2023 through 5-12-2025.csv")
```


# Filtering the stops
```{r}
wego_time_point_filter <- wego |> 
  group_by(CALENDAR_ID,TRIP_ID) |> 
  filter(all (c("WHBG", "MCC5_1") %in% TIME_POINT_ABBR)) |> #keep the group only if the both stops exist
  filter(
    ROUTE_STOP_SEQUENCE >= min(ROUTE_STOP_SEQUENCE[TIME_POINT_ABBR %in% c("WHBG", "MCC5_1")]) & #TIME_POINT_ABBR %in% c("WHBG", "MCC5_2") crates a logical vector (true,false) for each group Route_stop_seq with brackets selects the values where the condition is true.
    ROUTE_STOP_SEQUENCE <= max(ROUTE_STOP_SEQUENCE[TIME_POINT_ABBR %in% c("WHBG", "MCC5_1")])
  ) |> 
  
  filter(!(TIME_POINT_ABBR == "WHBG"  & ROUTE_DIRECTION_NAME == "TO DOWNTOWN"), #excluding the "WHBG" while going "To Downtown"
         !(TIME_POINT_ABBR == "MCC5_1" & ROUTE_DIRECTION_NAME == "FROM DOWNTOWN")) |> #excluding the "MCC5_2" while "FROM Downtown"
  ungroup()

```
			

# Extract the correct schedule time 
```{r}
wego_time_point_filter <- wego_time_point_filter |> 
  mutate(
    SCHEDULED_TIME = case_when(str_sub(SCHEDULED_TIME, 1, 4) == '1900' ~ str_sub(SCHEDULED_TIME, 12,-1),
    .default = SCHEDULED_TIME)) |>
   mutate(HOUR = hour(hms(SCHEDULED_TIME))) 
```


# Combining date and scheduled_time into a single column
```{r}
wego_time_point_filter <- wego_time_point_filter |> 
  filter((!is.na(DATE)) & (!is.na(SCHEDULED_TIME))) |> 
  mutate(
    #sched_time_clean = str_extract(SCHEDULED_TIME, "\\d{2}:\\d{2}:\\d{2}"),  #extract hms from SCHEDULED_TIME
    date_time_str = paste(DATE, SCHEDULED_TIME, sep = " "),  #combine columns into a single character string(date_time_str)
    datetime= ymd_hms(date_time_str) # Parse the character string into a POSIXct object
  ) |> 
  select(-date_time_str)
``` 


#calculating the headway percentage
```{r}
#TSP on [headway cond]= 2025-05-12 12pm to CURRENT/LAST DATE
#TSP Headway-Conditional TSP Priority Begins (Only gapped buses with actual leading headway more than 120% of scheduled headway receive priority)

  wego_time_point_filter <- wego_time_point_filter |> 
  mutate(HDWY_DEV_Perc = ACTUAL_HDWY/SCHEDULED_HDWY * 100) |> 
  filter(HDWY_DEV_Perc> 120) 
```


#case statement was running t00 slow , so created time variables to make it run fast
```{r}
t1 <- ymd_hms("2025-02-03 12:00:00")
t2 <- ymd_hms("2025-02-10 12:00:00")
t3 <- ymd_hms("2025-04-28 12:00:00")
t4 <- ymd_hms("2025-05-05 12:00:00")
t5 <- ymd_hms("2025-05-12 12:00:00")

```


# Create tsp Indicator variable for conditional and unconditional time phases
```{r}
wego_tsp <- wego_time_point_filter |> 
  mutate(
    tsp_phase = case_when(
      
#TSP on= 2025-02-03 12pm to 2025-02-10 12pm (unconditional)
     
   between(datetime,t1, t2) ~ 1,
     
     
     
#TSP ON [schedlue Cond]= 2025-02-10 12 pm to 2025-04-28 TSP  Priority Begins (Only buses more than 2 minutes late receive priority)
    between(datetime,t2,t3)   ~ 1 ,  #filters for more than 2 mins late


#TSP OFF= 2025-04-28 12pm to 2025-05-05 12pm
    between(datetime,t3,t4) ~ 0,


#TSP ON= 2025-05-05 12pm to 2025-05-12 at 12pm
   between(datetime, t4, t5)   ~ 1,


#TSP on [headway cond]= 2025-05-12 12pm to CURRENT/LAST DATE
#TSP Headway-Conditional TSP Priority Begins (Only gapped buses with actual leading headway more than 120% of scheduled headway receive priority) 
  
  (datetime>t5)  ~ 1, 
#filters for gapping (more hdwy than scheduled) and filter scheduled hdwy to not zero since it gives infinity values while calculating the hdwy percentage ~ 
  
  TRUE ~ 0)
  ) 
```


**Main Research Question:**Does Transit Signal Priority (TSP) reduce the probability that a bus leaves a stop late?

*Create a time_of_day column by using case_when to see how it effects the probability that bus leaves late

early_morning: 4:00 - 5:59
morning_peak: 6:00 - 8:59
midday: 9:00 - 14:59
pm_peak: 15:00 - 17:59
evening: 18:00 - 20:59
late_night: 21:00 - 1:59


* Create Time Of day column for different time periods with labels
```{r}
wego_tsp <- wego_tsp |> 
  
  mutate(time_of_day =case_when(
  between(hms(SCHEDULED_TIME),hms("4:00:00"),hms("5:59:00")) ~ "early_morning",
  between(hms(SCHEDULED_TIME),hms("6:00:00"),hms("8:59:00")) ~ "morning_peak",
  between(hms(SCHEDULED_TIME),hms("9:00:00"),hms("14:59:00")) ~ "midday",   
  between(hms(SCHEDULED_TIME),hms("15:00:00"),hms("17:59:00")) ~ "pm_peak",
  between(hms(SCHEDULED_TIME),hms("18:00:00"),hms("20:59:00")) ~ "evening",
  hms(SCHEDULED_TIME)>=hms("21:00:00") | hms(SCHEDULED_TIME)<=hms("1:59:00") ~ "late_night",
  between(hms(SCHEDULED_TIME),hms("2:00:00"),hms("3:59:00")) ~ "before_morning"))
```


* Create day of week and day type columns to see how it effects the probability that bus leaves late
```{r}
wego_tsp <- wego_tsp |> 
  
  mutate(day_of_week = wday(DATE,label = TRUE),
         day_number = wday(DATE, week_start = 1),
         day_type = if_else(day_number %in% c(6, 7), "Weekend", "Weekday")
  ) |> 
  select(-day_number)

```


* Create School session column to see how it effects the probability that bus leaves late
```{r}
wego_tsp <- wego_tsp |> 
  mutate(
    school_session = case_when(
      between(ymd(DATE), ymd("2023-01-01"), ymd("2023-05-28")) ~ "In School" ,
      between(ymd(DATE), ymd("2023-05-29"), ymd("2023-08-05")) ~ "Out School" ,
      between(ymd(DATE), ymd("2023-08-06"), ymd("2024-05-28")) ~ "In School" ,
      between(ymd(DATE), ymd("2024-05-29"), ymd("2024-08-05")) ~ "Out School" ,
      between(ymd(DATE), ymd("2024-08-06"), ymd("2025-05-12")) ~ "In School"
    )) 
```


* The TSP on and off proportion
```{r}
wego_tsp |>
  count(tsp_phase) |>
  mutate(
    proportion = n / sum(n)
  )
```


# Visualization of the effect of Tsp on Probability of bus being late
```{r}
wego_tsp |> 
  group_by(tsp_phase) |> 
  summarise(late_count = mean(ADJUSTED_LATE_COUNT)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=factor(tsp_phase), y = late_count)) +
  geom_col(fill=c("#FF6F68","#00B0BA"), width = 0.5)+
  scale_x_discrete(labels= c("0" = "tsp off", "1"= "tsp on"))+
  labs(x="Tsp Phase", y= "Probability of being late",
       title = "Effect of Tsp on proportion of bus lateness")

```


```{r}
wego_tsp$tsp_phase <- factor(wego_tsp$tsp_phase, levels=c(0,1), labels=c("tsp_off", "tsp_on"))
```

# visualization of  The probability of bus lateness by Time of Day and TSP Phase
```{r}
TSP_Time_of_day_plot <- wego_tsp |> 
  group_by(time_of_day, tsp_phase) |> 
  summarise(pc_late = mean(ADJUSTED_LATE_COUNT), .groups = "drop") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=time_of_day, y = pc_late, fill= factor(tsp_phase))) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),width = 0.5, na.rm =TRUE)+

    values = c("tsp_off" = "#FF6F68", "tsp_on" = "#00B0BA"),

  #facet_wrap(~tsp_phase, labeller=as_labeller(c("0"="tsp off", "1"= "tsp on")))+

       title = "The probability of bus lateness by Time of Day and TSP Phase")
ggsave("TSP_Time_of_day_lateness_plot.png", width = 6, height = 3, dpi=300)
```

"Buses are less likely to be late when TSP is active, especially during peak times".

# Creating logistic regression model with target variable ADJUSTED_LATE_COUNT and predictor variable tsp_phase and control variables.
```{r}
lm_tsp_late <- glm(ADJUSTED_LATE_COUNT ~  tsp_phase + time_of_day + day_of_week + school_session +TIME_POINT_ABBR, data = wego_tsp, family="binomial")
summary(lm_tsp_late)
```
```{r}
lm_tsp_late_summary <- summary(lm_tsp_late) 
lm_tsp_late_summary$coefficients[ ,c("Estimate","Pr(>|z|)")] 
```

```{r}
coef_tsp <- coef(lm_tsp_late)["tsp_phasetsp_on"]
odds_ratio <- exp(coef_tsp) #e^(-0.145194)
odds_ratio
```

*In the logistic regression model the coefficient for TSP being on is -0.145194 and p-value 8.76e-06(p<0.05), indicating that activating TSP significantly reduces the likelihood of bus lateness.

*Interpreted as an odds ratio, buses operating with TSP enabled have approximately 13.5% lower odds of bus being late compared to periods when TSP is off, controlling for time of day, day of week, school session and stop location.


# Calculate the AIC of a model using different controlled variable and taking the less AIC value variable as controlled variables 
```{r}
lm_tsp_late_cv <- glm(ADJUSTED_LATE_COUNT ~  tsp_phase + school_session , data = wego_tsp, family="binomial")
summary(lm_tsp_late_cv)
```


```{r}
lm_tsp_late <- glm(ADJUSTED_LATE_COUNT ~  tsp_phase , data = wego_tsp, family="binomial")
summary(lm_tsp_late)
```

```{r}
aic_time_day <- AIC(lm_tsp_late_cv, lm_tsp_late)
```

```{r}
aic_day_week <- AIC(lm_tsp_late_cv, lm_tsp_late)
```

```{r}
aic_school <- AIC(lm_tsp_late_cv, lm_tsp_late)
```

*We fit various logistic regression models based on different combinations of these variables and chose the model with the lowest AIC


#How much does the TSP reduce the average bus delay time?

* Create a Linear regression model ADHERENCE as a target variable
```{r}
#ADHERENCE: Difference between actual departure time and scheduled time; negative indicates departure time after scheduled time and positive indicates departure time before scheduled time. Generally, on-time is considered to be no more than 6 minutes lates and no more than one minute early.


lm_tsp_Adherence <- glm(ADHERENCE ~ tsp_phase +time_of_day + day_of_week + school_session +TIME_POINT_ABBR , data = wego_tsp)
summary(lm_tsp_Adherence)

```

```{r}
lm_tsp_Adherence_summary <- summary(lm_tsp_Adherence) 
lm_tsp_Adherence_summary$coefficients[ ,c("Estimate","Pr(>|t|)")] 
```


* When TSP is activated, average bus schedule adherence improve by approximately 0.50 minutes(about 30 seconds), indicating reduced lateness.
*The coefficient for TSP activation is statistically significant(p= 1.96×10^-6), showing that TSP has a significant association with bus schedule adherence after controlling other variables like Time of Day, Day of Week, School Session and stop location. 



# Create a visualization Effect of TSP phase on Bus Lateness.
```{r}
mean_adherence <- wego_tsp |> 
  group_by( tsp_phase) |> 
  summarise(avg_Adherence= mean(ADHERENCE, na.rm =TRUE)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(tsp_phase = factor(tsp_phase, levels=c("tsp_off","tsp_on")))

```

```{r}
  TSP_avg_lateness_plot <- ggplot(mean_adherence, aes(x=tsp_phase , y= -avg_Adherence, fill=tsp_phase))+
  geom_col(width = 0.5)+
  geom_label(
    aes(label = round(avg_Adherence, 2)),
     )+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("tsp_off"="#FF6F68", "tsp_on" ="#00B0BA")) +
  labs(x="TSP Phase", 
       y= "Average Lateness (minutes)",
       title = "Effect of TSP phase on Bus Lateness",
       subtitle = "higher values = more late",
       fill = "tsp_phase")
ggsave("TSP_Avg_lateness_plot.png", width = 6, height = 3, dpi=300)

```



* We can apply the Bonferroni correction to the p-values in our model since we had many explanatory variables.

```{r}
tidy(lm_tsp_Adherence) |>
  mutate(p.value = p.adjust(p.value, method = "bonferroni"))
```
